blocks.title: Permanent dipole-permanent dipole force
blocks.text: Ek polar molecule ke musbat sire aur qareebi polar molecule ke manfi sire ke darmiyan kashish ki quwwat permanent dipole-permanent dipole force (pd-pd) kehlati hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: qatar mein chaar polar molecules, har aik ka d+ aur d- sira, sir se dum tak kashish. Darmiyan: HCl molecules is tarah ke aik ka H (d+) agle ke Cl (d-) ke saamne, dashed kashish se jure. Neeche: chloroform (CHCl3) ke do molecules, aik ka H (d+) agle ke Cl ki taraf khincha.
blocks.caption: HCl aur chloroform mein permanent dipole - permanent dipole forces (Figure 5.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jab bhi HCl molecules ek doosre ke qareeb hon, jaise liquid halat mein, woh musbat sire se manfi sire tak qatar mein lagne ka rujhan rakhte hain. Aisi hi forces chloroform, CHCl3, ke molecules ke darmiyan hain, jis ka musbat markaz hydrogen atom par aur manfi markaz chlorine atoms wale sire par hai.

blocks.prompt: Misalon ke saath id-id aur pd-pd forces mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces electron badal ki lamhati na-hamwari se paida hoti hain aur sab molecules ke darmiyan kaam karti hain, aur Cl2, CCl4 aur noble gases jaise non-polar maddon mein wahid forces hain. Permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces sirf un polar molecules ke darmiyan kaam karti hain jo pehle se mustaqil dipole rakhte hain, jaise HCl aur CHCl3, jo musbat se manfi ki qatar mein lagte hain.

items: Permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces: ek polar molecule ka musbat sira agle ke manfi sire ko khinchta hai; HCl aur chloroform is tarah qatar mein lagte hain.
